title: Compile a .michi file to a .sh script
body: One line per expanded command, settings as comments above it. A way to check expansion by hand and a golden-file test oracle for the parser: tests/*.michi against expected *.sh.
close_reason: sh.rs generates the script, tests/golden.rs checks it against tests/cases/*.sh and with bash -n; reviewed and fixed

notes.author: Jack Roddy/a556920e
notes.text: Decided 2026-10-08: the script is bash. Data blocks become arrays named block_KEY, sweeps become for loops with command text unchanged and $N left to bash, tuple lists become one array per component with an index loop, ranges are written out as literal words, attributes become comments, blank lines between sections. The generator reads the resolved tree, before sweep expansion.
